caption: Every number in this chapter comes out of this chain. Notice the two places where accuracy is lost: the peg that makes the signal absolute, and the 1° encoder that time-stamps it.

spec.title: From cylinder to numbers
spec.aria: Block diagram of the pressure measurement chain, from the cylinder through the piezoelectric transducer, charge amplifier and crank-angle data logger to the final imep, peak pressure and cycle-to-cycle variation.
